papers.title: OpenThoughts-Agent: Data Recipes for Agentic Models
papers.abstract: Agentic language models dramatically expand the applications of AI yet little is publicly known about how to curate training data for broadly capable agents. Existing open efforts such as SWE-Smith, SERA, and Nemotron-Terminal typically target a single benchmark, leaving open the question of how to train models that generalize across diverse agentic tasks. The OpenThoughts-Agent (OT-Agent) project addresses this gap with a fully open data curation pipeline for training agentic models. We conduct
papers.llm_reason: 直击 Agent 工程最稀缺的公开知识——'用什么训练数据、按什么配方，才能训出跨多类任务泛化的 Agentic 模型'。现有开源努力(SWE-Smith/SERA/Nemotron-Terminal)基本只盯单一 benchmark，本文给出一条完全开放的数据策展流水线并研究跨任务泛化，这恰好是自有 Agent 落地团队天天面对的问题(单任务过拟合、换场景就崩)。理论上是'数据配比即能力边界'，工程上可直接迁移为'多 benchmark 混合 SFT/RL 配方实验'，今天就能起最小验证。证据以方法+多 benchmark 对照为主，作者为 OpenThoughts 系列延续，方向可信；代码与复现入口暂无/待核验。

papers.title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs
papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn manipulation skills from demonstrations, but their capabilities are bounded by the skills in the training data. We present InSight, a framework that unlocks autonomous skill acquisition by rendering VLAs steerable at the primitive-action level (e.g., "move gripper to the bowl", "lift upward", "pour the bottle"). papers.llm_reason: VLA(视觉-语言-动作)模型的能力被训练数据里的技能集合封顶，InSight 把它做成'可在原子动作层 steer'——先用 VL 自动把示教切分成带标签的 primitive(move/pour/lift)，再在推理时按指令组合。'技能=可命名、可组合的原子动作'这个抽象对所有 Agent 都成立(不只是机器人)：把长程任务分解为可复用 primitive 库、运行时按目标重组。这是 embodied/具身 Agent 与 skill library/分层规划趋势的核心命题。属方向性趋势而非可立即上线(机器人专属、无代码)，但概念贡献强、来自 Stanford(Wu)团队，证据待核验。

papers.title: New Bounds for the Last Iterate of the Stochastic subGradient Method
papers.abstract: We study the last iterate of the stochastic subgradient method for one-dimensional convex Lipschitz objectives. For a fixed horizon $n$, we consider the standard fixed stepsizes $η=Θ(1/\sqrt n)$. We prove that, for such stepsize policies, under additive i.i.d. subgradient noise with uniformly bounded variance, the last iterate features an optimization error of order $1/\sqrt n$, thereby removing the extra $(\log n)$ factor present in existing generic bounds. papers.title: It's Complicated: On the Design and Evaluation of AI-Powered AAC Interfaces
papers.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) can enhance what people who use augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) are able to do with their systems. However, evaluating AI-powered AAC interfaces can be difficult. People are intersectional beings and current evaluation metrics can struggle to capture the multifaceted and nuanced desires people may have for their AAC. papers.title: World Models in Pieces: Structural Certification for General Agents
papers.abstract: In the big-world regime, agents cannot be universally capable and their ability is inevitably specialized across a world model in pieces. Consequently, standard uniform guarantees fail to distinguish between the understanding of critical bottlenecks and irrelevant failures. We first formalize this limitation by proving that general agents are not universal, rendering standard worst-case analysis uninformative. papers.abstract: Agentic data analysis systems produce rich outputs, including code, numerical results, and verbal diagnostics. This makes them more challenging to evaluate than single-turn LLM responses. papers.abstract: Unified multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong text-to-image generation quality, but still struggle with structure-aware prompt following, where object counts, spatial relations, attribute bindings, and coarse layouts must be preserved. papers.abstract: Prompt-based learning has emerged as a dominant paradigm in natural language processing.
